SELECT DISTINCT sp_method.symbol_id AS symbol_id
FROM code.symbols AS base_cls
JOIN code.class_ancestry AS ca ON ca.ancestor_symbol_id = base_cls.symbol_id
JOIN code.symbols AS sub_cls ON sub_cls.symbol_id = ca.class_symbol_id
JOIN code.files AS f ON f.file_id = sub_cls.file_id
JOIN code.symbol_profile AS sp_method ON sp_method.enclosing_class_symbol_id = sub_cls.symbol_id
WHERE base_cls.name = 'SQLDatabase'
  AND base_cls.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py'
  AND base_cls.kind = 'class'
  AND ca.depth = 1
  AND sub_cls.kind = 'class'
  AND f.is_test = false
  AND sp_method.name = 'get_columns'
  AND sp_method.kind = 'method'
  AND sp_method.is_method = true
  AND sp_method.has_docstring = false
ORDER BY symbol_id
